cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Just Say Yes
cards.instruction: Get a quick approval before anyone has time to examine the practical consequences.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Just nod and I'll accept the sofa delivery.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Will it fit through the door?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. We can measure after securing the bargain.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then nod before they start measuring too.

mechanism: A reserves permission for practical examination until after a quick nod, using the delivery arrival to hurry B past consequences.
confusable: Ordinary enthusiasm for a bargain is not enough: assent must be sought before fit is checked, with A ruling on the order.
comparison: Immediate sofa delivery creates physical time pressure, unlike the party booking deadline and unread cost quotation.
seedUse: The existing D28-b decision restriction directly supports the premature-approval tactic and can be retained with its exact wording.
